## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Adoption should preserve files when the incoming value already matches: the new branch reports a change and rewrites unchanged configuration.

## Changes
The pull request adds adoption mode, records adopted keys, and adds tests for adoption and replacement updates.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/config.py:15 — correctness — Preserve files when adopting identical values — With existing content `{"theme":"dark"}` and incoming `{"theme": "dark"}`, `adopt=True` records `theme` and rewrites the file despite identical values. This breaks the module's stated preservation behavior; the tests read cover unchanged replacement but only changed-value adoption. — Callers receive a false change report, and users lose their original JSON formatting when adopting an already configured value.
